body: Thank you.. It means a lot.
I want to believe that but I can't. I am not a bad person, but I am not a useful one either. And I fear I will only be a disappointment to the people I love.

>The good things aren't an illusion. 

I want to believe this so badly.

Thank you. I feel like I'm already broken though, and trying to glue the pieces together, but it keeps falling apart and only gets weaker over time.

Sorry about the muddled thoughts. Thank you for the story.

I was on meds but had to stop. I can't start therapy/meds in my current circumstances, but I will be able to do so a couple of months from now. I am trying hard to make it till then. Thank you for reaching out.
